what: P3C-1 identifier-ownership regressions: the notices whose printed best-by, packaging and lot markings were promoted into the Barcode (UPC) field because their digit runs happened to be a UPC-compatible length.
provenance: Two kinds of evidence, deliberately distinguished. `excerpts` are bounded verbatim announcement text from archived FDA source snapshots, and drive the shared extractor end to end. `auditLedger` records notices the pre-fix production audit measured but whose payload was NOT archived: it holds the exact values that rendered in the barcode field and the label the audit found governing each one — the source wording is not stated here because it was never captured, and nothing in this file is reconstructed or invented.

excerpts.nativeTitle: Dynarex Corporation Expands Recall to Include Additional Products Due to Possible Health Risk
excerpts.provenance: Bounded verbatim excerpt of the announcement text preserved in this notice's archived FDA source snapshot, read during the read-only P3C audit on 2026-09-04. Only the sentences that state the recall quantity and the package identifiers are kept — this is NOT a recorded page, and it does not extend full-snapshot corpus coverage.
excerpts.excerpt:
Montvale, NJ, October 28, 2024 — Dynarex Corporation is expanding the recall initiated on September 19, 2024 , to include an additional 373 cases of item number 4875, Dynacare Baby Powder, 14 oz., as well as 647 cases of item number 4874, Dynacare Baby Powder, 4 oz ., because they have the potential to be contaminated with asbestos. Asbestos is a naturally occurring mineral that is often found near talc, an ingredient in many cosmetic products. Asbestos, however, is a known carcinogen and its health risks are well-documented. If talc mining sites are not carefully chosen or if proper steps are not taken to adequately purify the talc ore, it may contain asbestos.
Both the 4875 and 4874 Baby Powder products are packaged in plastic bottles, 24 bottles to a case for the 14 oz. and 48 to a case for the 4 oz., with lot/batch numbers located on the bottom of the bottle and on each case (see images below).

expect.note: No barcode is stated anywhere in this notice. It is here for the quantity narrative, and for the deferred day-first Mfg. Dt./Exp. Dt. columns recorded below.

excerpts.deferred: The notice's product table carries "Mfg. Dt." and "Exp. Dt." columns whose values are DAY-first ("01.11.2023"). A month-first reading would misstate them, so those columns stay unsupported and hidden (P3C-1 deliberately adds no label support for them).
